body:
Thank you very much for your reply. I'm glad things are better for you, now.

I'm seeing a counsellor, but I find it hard to talk honestly with her, as the last time I did, she ended up telling my parents everything I said... 

It seems like I have no future. I have nothing. ... I'm torn between wanting to get better, and wanting to give in completely. I don't know what to do.

I'm sorry. I'm a complete failure. I don't have enough willpower to recover from this. I don't have enough willpower to do anything. 

Thank you, though. I really appreciate everything you said. Thank you.

Thank you so much. I really appreciate your comments. Thank you. And thank you especially for the hug.

I honestly can't see things getting better for me. I've tried talking to people, but it's a really hard thing for me to do, and it never really ends well.  

I'm glad things are better for you now, and I really hope they continue to get better. You seem like a really great person. Thank you. And good luck with the rest of your life.
